title: CADENCE: a toolkit for cardiac optical-mapping signal processing and analysis
description:
CADENCE is an end-to-end toolkit for processing and analyzing cardiac optical-mapping recordings (transmembrane voltage and intracellular calcium): data conversion, signal conditioning, feature extraction (activation, APD/repolarization, conduction velocity, calcium kinetics, alternans, and arrhythmia/rotor dynamics), and visualization/analysis.

Distributed as a standalone macOS application requiring no MATLAB license, plus the full MATLAB App Designer source. This release accompanies the CADENCE manuscript.
